scientific_review.question: 增加向量值映射的网格变形及局部平行四边形对照，固定映射和Jacobian，说明有限非线性像与一阶近似不同并承接体积换元。

facts.grid: 6 lines per coordinate, 201 samples per line; 81 samples per cell edge
facts.comparison: green curved cell is exact map, dashed parallelogram is T(a)+J_T(a)(u-a); not identical at finite size

scientific_review.basis: Analytic identities and domain checks; plotted finite windows do not replace proofs.

reader_review.caption: 取$T(u,v)=(u+v^2/4,\,0.6v+0.3u^2)$，$a=(0.5,0.5)$。(a) 输入网格及绿色小方块。(b) 非线性像为弯边块，黑虚线为$T(a)+J_T(a)(h,k)^\top$给出的平行四边形；$J_T(a)=\bigl[\begin{smallmatrix}1&0.25\\0.3&0.6\end{smallmatrix}\bigr]$。有限块不与线性像完全重合，缩小扰动后才由可微余项控制差异。
